zc601_u252_30k_observed_v1.label: DJI video-link recording signature,20MHz observation profile

training.method: Independent CP/quadratic-reference fit found601/root252 at30kHz. Nominal20MHz envelope inferred from18.03MHz reference grid,not controller readback.

limitations: Recording-validated20MHz observation profile,not a universal DJI/O4+ or Mavic4 protocol decoder
Reference signature matching is not MAC CRC,payload decryption,video recovery or aircraft identity
30kHz CP structure alone does not establish DJI or NR
20MHz box is a nominal observation envelope; reference-active span is18.03MHz; full burst occupied width is not calibrated
Other mode real-time performance measurements do not establish continuous20MHz hardware performance
